horoscopes.horoscope: You will desire absolute freedom in whatever you do today. A lot of entertainment is on the cards for teenagers, like window shopping or going for a movie. Kids may demand a treat from you. Generally, family affairs dominate today. A mushy conversation with your darling is on the cards. Have a brainstorming session with your lover tonight to boost your romance. You may get some fantastic ideas and turn wild and naughty to please your sweetheart. Have fun. After all, it’s good for your emotional appeal, says Ganesha. Your heart will be full of joy. Rs a result, you shall glow and spread happiness wherever you go today. Naturally, the positive vibes will also get reflected on your health and well-being. In high spirits, you shall swiftly complete your tasks. Today you will be concerned about financial planning and long term security. Your desire to have more stable financial graph will increase, and you will pay more attention to expenditure. An ideal day to put forward best of your efforts, suggests Ganesha. You will feel confident and energetic today. Since you are determined to do so, you will finish all your tasks within the deadline. The pressures will ease off in the evening, foresees Ganesha.

Today you are going to focus on enhancing your looks and appearances, says Ganesha. Instead of trying to seek satisfaction from within yourself you will be flaunting your fine clothes, your hairstyles. A visit to a beauty parlour cannot be ruled out. Your new looks will make you tremendously confident and impressive and will make others see you in a now light. Have no fears. You have a great day ahead. Love life will blossom as you may adopt creative ways to win your partner’s heart. You may play some romantic tunes and hold your partner softly while cooking your favourite dish or caress your sweetheart while watching a favourite romantic movie. A fun-filled time is on the cards, feels Ganesha. Fitness will be on the top of your priority list for today. Overflowing with energy and enthusiasm, you shall easily meet the deadlines of all your tasks. With enough time to spare, you will devote the evening just for exercising. Today you may wish to buy new ornaments or jewelry. You will be willing to present yourself as a charming person in social functions, thus you may wish to buy branded clothes that look classy. Today is the best time to launch new projects and decide the plan of action for ongoing ones. Meetings on financial issues should go well. Today you will be able to decide independently on important matters, says Ganesha.

You will make a reputation for yourself as a leader in your social circle. You yearn for something in your heart, and need to concentrate your energies upon attaining it. Your creative mind will come up with solutions today, to certain questions that have been perplexing you for quite some, says Ganesha. You may refresh yourself in the company of your loved one by spending quality time with him or her. You may sweeten your relationship by giving gifts to your loved one. A romantic evening keeps both of you engaged, foresees Ganesha. You may have to toil on this challenging day. But, if you expect immediate results, you shall get disappointed. You have tried your best, however the planets are less favourable. Just continue the good work – tomorrow will be better. On the financial front, today you shall be a bit careful. You may, however, end up paying too much for some immediate requirement. Ganesha advises you to do proper market research before buying anything. Fruitless pursuits may eat away your time today, foresees Ganesha. Ensure that your hard work doesn’t just go to the ‘recycle bin’. Concentration on work may certainly give you a productive day, suggests Ganesha.

It is high time that you dedicated yourself to your work. If you are looking to try new things, today may not be a very good day to do so. Stick to doing things the way you have been doing them so far, advises Ganesha. All you need is a little attitude adjustment. Today, you are likely to meet an old friend and you will get busy reminiscing about your time together. You will remain stress-free today and enjoy peace of mind. This will bring a smile on your face. A delightful evening with your partner is on the cards. Discussing the future with spouse will be the best idea, suggests Ganesha. You need to delegate work to people whom you can count on. You should not take all the load yourself as it might drain your energy. Besides, your aura would be positive today so you could make new friends who too will be helpful. If you have you been thinking of going out for a movie, or planning a dinner with your beloved, or looking to woo someone of the opposite sex just by spending money, then today is an auspicious day. It’s the best day for group activities. You will be in the right frame of mind to perform well in the meetings. Your diligence and commitment to work shall reward you in future, foresees Ganesha. You will have a nice day to talk to your HR regarding salary hike, bonus or incentives.

You will relentlessly try to find means to progress at the workplace today. You will remain steadfast in your resolutions. You will not allow those working under you to slack. You will need to let go of your inhibitions and fears to be happy in life. You will receive the benifice of highly placed superiors, says Ganesha. Being busy and bossy in work may turn off your sweetheart. Relationship with your loved one must be handled tactfully. You will simply put aside your love life due to excess work. Sending funny jokes or romantic notes will keep him or her happy, says Ganesha. From morning, you shall be full of beans. Needless to say, you will readily take up tasks that are challenging. Success will easily come your way, and boost your morale. Refrain from debating trifle matters to maintain your good mood. You need to be extremely careful while lending money, as it will be very difficult for you to recover it. Today you can start some project of your own which later turn out to be monetarily beneficial. Your creativity will see its maximum boost. Ganesha feels that since your creativity will be emphasized today, you will be more imaginative. You will tend to be ambidextrous and score high on productivity, says Ganesha.

Children will ring in applauds and praises – in the classroom and off it too! Processing logic and reasoning will improve too. Ganesha asks you to keep calm and enjoy the joy ride, irrespective of anything that happens during the day. Your mercurial spirit is so high today that you may not be able to finalize your most desired travel destination. You will be busy drawing up plans for a trip with your family or beloved. A historical place or a jungle trip seem to be on your cards now, feels Ganesha. You will be in good health and humour today. Your plans will work out well. You will be supported by luck. This is the best time to charge yourself by doing activities which you like the most. You will stay more practical and composed. On this day, luck will be in your favour with respect to money matters. Your approach towards expenses will help you. You will be research well buying or selling anything. Luck is on your side today. You will be the champion in the mind of your boss. With a practical attitude, you will excel at your work. Your boss will be more than happy with you as you will finish all tasks on time.

Unleash the artist in you today! Don’t be surprised if you happen to discover a love for the fine arts. The stars bestow on you refined aesthetic sense. As a result, your penchant for interior decoration is sure to get a boost. There is also the possibility of you capitalising on the commercial aspect of your newly acquired hobby, says Ganesha. You like to be in an experimental mood. Your fascination for beautiful clothes, perfume and accessories will drive your partner crazy. Your sensuality will mesmerise your lover into whipping up a romantic mood for a steamy interlude. Today will be all about health and well-being. Review your food habits and follow a balanced diet plan. Eat healthy food at regular intervals throughout the day to keep fit. Exercise daily, take adequate sleep, and avoid long working hours. It is unlikely that today you shall find any logic behind your current financial status and will be wondering how to progress. Ganesha feels that this is the time to sit back, relax and be happy with what you have. An excellent day for showing off your creative side. In fact, if you are designing a software, a few random changes might jazz up the entire thing! You will be able to deliver the best project under a strict deadline, feels Ganesha.

Family matters have been screaming for long for your attention now. Your estranged spouse may deal the final blow to sever all ties, foretells Ganesha. But keep calm, and hold that tongue, advises Ganesha. Your priority should be to secure your family’s peace. You are loyal and faithful to your loved one. You will listen to your sweetheart with your heart’s content. Love life should be harmonious as you will agree to anything said or decided by your beloved, says Ganesha. Work may be piling on your desk, but your body is sending signals to your mind. Listen to your inner voice – it is time to go home. Avoid working late hours – relax in the evening with loved ones to revitalise yourself. Today is an auspicious day to arrange a get-together and spend big money on a big party. This is also a favourable day to invest some money on informal business parties or conferences. Meetings at the office will go well, by the grace of Ganesha. However, you may have to agree to your colleagues’ point of view. Mingling with your colleagues can give you a sense of belonging. You need to maintain your dignity.

The cloud of worries is likely to keep you gloomy today. Try to burst that cloud, and take a decision that would help you to solve your troubles. There may be some delay, if you want the situation to get back to normal. However, as Ganesha says, you would be the one who would benefit at the end of the day!. Balance your professional and personal life so well that neither is ignored. You may not be able to spend adequate time with your sweetheart. You have to be courageous as you may get detached. Get ready to woo and please your loved one, suggests Ganesha. Generally you devote time for your job/business and family, but hardly spend time for yourself. Make sure you allot some time for yourself. Go to a hill-station or holiday resort to seek solitude and achieve peace of mind, advises Ganesha. Today you shall learn how to save money. You will think twice before buying anything and unless it is essential, you shall avoid it. This is a good time to borrow money to legitimate needs. Ganesha foresees a busy day for you today. Even if your colleagues are whiling away time, you may slog at work. A variety of work will come your way and you will feel indecisive. You may not be able to keep up the expected speed, feels Ganesha.

There are good days and bad days; your day today will oscillate between the two extremes, says Ganesha. While on the one hand, your mind will be flooded with negative feelings that will make you feel miserable, on the other, your efforts at work will yield good results in the future. The need of the hour is to stay calm and take criticisms in your stride. Dealing patiently with chaotic situations will pay off in the long run. You will be able to fulfill your sweetheart’s demands. Getting close to him or her will be easy. Lovers will find the intensity of love at a dizzying peak, says Ganesha with a wink. You will finally be able to develop a great bond in the relationship. After completing all your daily tasks, spend some time to play your favourite game or sport, in order to rejuvenate your mind and body. In the evening, you should go to a multi-cuisine restaurant to treat yourself and your loved ones. Ganesha feels that today is a favourable day to plan your budget for the long-term. However, stars are not in favor of investing in real estate. Money may be spent on leisure activities. Ganesha advises you to handle official meetings judiciously. Decision making will prove your forte. You may develop new professional skills which inspire you to embark on an ambitious project. Sort out important problems as it may jeopardize its progress.

The day is taxing. You may find that others have dumped their share of work on you. But you are not one to admit defeat, and will deal with the challenge squarely, says Ganesha. You will outwit your opponents, and toast your success by starlight!. Fortunately, you will spend quality time with your family members or your sweetheart, says Ganesha. You will bring many changes to domestic lifestyles. Your partner may help you understand the meaning of true love and commitment. After working very hard during the last few days, the time has come to take a break and give rest to your tired muscles and bored mind. You will therefore feel like doing something different and interesting to refresh yourself. Today you may buy handicraft items to decorate your home. You can arrange a movie show at home with friends and relatives or can plan to invite them for lunch or dinner. Troubleshooting might present major hassles at work today. Directed projects might land up on your table and you may have to follow your superiors’ orders. You will be busy in fulfilling your promise . Quality will be your priority, feels Ganesha.

While your day is unlikely to be very satisfactory, keeping your expectations low will help lessen your disappointment, says Ganesha. However, the evening is likely to be as refreshing as your day was depressing, with all the socialising in store for you. A rollicking party awaits you with good food, wine and music as accompaniments. You may turn curious and discuss some whys and hows today rather than mere facts. Intellectual discussions with your loved one will quench your thirst for knowledge, assures Ganesha. You may close the discussion with some interesting banter and exciting remarks. Expect a change on this unusual day. You may feel physically drained and mentally exhausted as you will overtax yourself, especially your mind. Try to strike the right balance between work and leisure. Just take a break to regain fitness. Spending money behind projects or assignments would be worth it. Your creativity shall peak and you will be good with words so it’s the best time to do something that can be financially helpful. You may feel confused in the new projects in the morning. With clouds of confusion getting cleared today, you will emerge a winner. Despite hurdles, you may be able to meet deadlines at the end of the evening.
